notes.title: Playtest 3 Update 1
notes.content:
[h1]Playtest 3 Update 1[/h1]
First off, huge thanks to everyone who’s helped by submitting feedback! It will definitely help shape the future!  

This weekend, I’ve been working on making a new upgrade building for when you can.  The new building is already in, but the functionality for upgrading isn’t quite there….yet. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/RoAT2LQ.jpeg][img]https://i.imgur.com/RoAT2LQ.jpeg[/img][/url]
[url=https://i.imgur.com/oPo42rZ.jpeg][img]https://i.imgur.com/oPo42rZ.jpeg[/img][/url]
[url=https://i.imgur.com/mRsm3ab.jpeg][img]https://i.imgur.com/mRsm3ab.jpeg[/img][/url]

[h2]Pallet Jacks[/h2]
I know there's a lot of contention around the Pallet Jack. It's been a very difficult item to get the feel of properly. I do have an idea for the approach I am going to take with it, however that has been giving me nothing but issues. I promise I'm am working on a solution that will let this happen, as I have a bunch of ideas to go along with it.

[h2]Updates and Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] You can now take up between 1 and 4 hour naps
[*] You can now start/continue wrapping pallets without going into the clipboard (Look at the pallet, press E)
[*] Added “Next Day Shipping” button in cart menu.
[*] Swapped “Manage Orders” and “Wrap Pallet” buttons 
[*] Able to unwrap pallets either fully, or 10% at a time through the clipboard
[*] No longer able to take products off pallets that are wrapped
[*] New pallet context:
[list]
[*] Pallets with orders will show what they have on them, as well as what they require
[*] Pallets without orders will show what is on them
[/list]
[*] Multiplayer buttons in the start menu disabled (they weren’t supposed to be enabled…whoops!)
[*] Removed the Stamina bar (Unneeded screen clutter)
[*] Fixed shipping calculations
[*] Fixed the estimated Income for new orders
[*] Fixed Pallets loading improperly from saved games
[*] Fixed order descriptions disappearing/not showing full information on active orders
[*] Fixed highlights hightlghting the incorrect highlights.
[*] Removed some old tutorial steps that no longer applicable
[*] Fixed a bug where stats wouldn’t save properly
[*] Build version was updated to reflect the version of the build. 
[/list]

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
This is very early on in the build, but there is a lot already in the works, soon to come out, and planned.  Here’s a short list

[list]
[*] [h3]Sooner[/h3]
[list]
[*] Building Upgrading
[list]
[*] If you’ve played you’ll have already seen an objective to upgrade…
[/list]
[*] Printer
[/list]
[*] [h3]Later[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pallet Wrapping Machine
[*] Scanner
[list]
[*] This will be the upgrade item that will replace your clipboard. 
[/list]
[*] Forklift
[*] Hiring Employees (NPC’s)
[*] …
[/list]

notes.title: Update and Play test
notes.content:
The Warehouse Doors Are Open—For a While!

Ever wanted to run your own fulfillment center without the risk of forklifting your career into a wall? Now’s your chance! This playtest is sticking around for a while, giving you plenty of time to stack, wrap, and ship your way to logistics mastery.

Before you dive in, here are a few things you should know:

[expand type=details expanded=false]
[list]
[*] [h2]Objectives[/h2]
[list]
[*] The newest system I was working on, I am quite happy with it so far!
[*] A few beginning objectives to help make learning the game easier
[/list]


[*] [h2]Pallet Jack[/h2]
[list]
[*] There's a new way to operate the pallet jack!  
[*] The new Objectives system includes a short briefing on how to use it. 
[/list]

[*] [h2]Character Stats[/h2]
[list]
[*] There are currently 4 statistics you can upgrade
[list]
  [*] Strength
  [list]
    [*] Affects how many cases you can pick up at a time
    [/list]
  [*] Charisma
    [list]
    [*] Effects how much clients will order from you, as well as the chances of ordering
    [/list]
  [*] Intimidation
    [list]
    [*]  [b][WIP][/b]
    [/list]
  [*] Agility.
    [list]
    [*] Effects your stamina
    [*] Small effect on your strength
    [*] Small effect on how quickly you can wrap pallets
    [/list]
  [/list]
[/list]


[*] [h2]Wrapping[/h2]
[list]
[*] An option step in the shipping process
[*] Unwrapped pallets could lead to damaged or lost cases
[*] Damaged/lost cases will result in loss of income, as well as reduced renown with your clients.
[/list]
[/list]
[/expand]

notes.title: Playtest #3 is Live!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that Playtest #3 for Fulfillment Center Simulator is now live! This round includes new gameplay tweaks, bug fixes, and your feedback in action.

One of the first and biggest changes:

New Map! [img]https://i.imgur.com/9AMEyHZ.jpeg[/img]

Jump in, test it out, and let me know your thoughts! Your input is shaping the future of the game.

Playtest ends on Sunday at 11:59pm. Don't miss it!

Happy testing, and thank you for your support!

[url=https://forms.gle/UQvZkNFuaHjeLoYX8]I'm looking for your feedback! Help me out by filling out this form![/url]

notes.title: Help is on the way, Dear!
notes.content:
We've heard a few cries for help when it comes to indicating how to unlock a door directly on screen, so we've made adjustments! 


We also noticed the player renown wasn't increasing as fast as we would have liked, so we increased that 2.5x.   What does player renown do, you ask?  The higher the player renown, the more products you unlock to be able to sell!  Maybe we should put that in the tutorial somewhere...
